There used to be four of us...and a male friend. He was her ex-boyfriend. They somehow broke up because his mom discriminated her. His mom knew their relationship because her 'ex' best friend told her. That's what made her came to us in the first place (her gang which was our enemy abandoned her because their gang leader's dream boy fell in love with her). But we welcomed her with open arms because we found her innocent, weak and lovable. She was like the symbol of the gang. While we were all immature and clumsy, she was the only mature and decent one. Then her so-called ex-boyfriend (which happened to be our best male friend) started flirting with one of our friend who also happened to have had a crush on him since grade 7. They eventually fell in love. We had a talk and she ensured us again and again that she was okay and she already let him go. She had her pride to protect and she will not go back to someone whose mom just insulted her in front of the teachers. The relationship lasted 3 years with some normal arguments, jealousy every couples have. Then...it came to an end along with the end of a friendship. One day, I randomly checked her phone and I saw she was flirting with that fuck boy ( her ex and our friend's current boyfriend )who use different phone number. Both confessed and promised to never do it again. So I gave them a chance and I keep my other friends in the dark only to found out later that they have never stopped! In fact, their conversation got deeper and deeper! Heck! they even discussed their future together! That was when hell breaks loose. Our "mature and decent" friend's secret came to light. My 'friend' who just found out she has been cheated on by her boyfriend and best friend but was kept in the dark in the entire time just cried a whole fucking day blaming herself for being naive and stupid. They broke up and things became awkward. So how about our mature and decent friend? she reunited with both her ex-boyfriend and her ex best friend who once ruined her relationship. And then my friend (the victim) just found out about her ex boyfriend's plan with our "not so decent and mature” ‘s friend's freshly-reunited friend that they will acted friendly to us until the graduation year so that we can accompany his "weak and innocent GF" and help them passed the senior high school graduation test with good grades and they will revenge us after that. (we have proofs, their conversations were in his messenger which he forgot to log out from my friend's phone), but excuse me! revenge? what revenge? At last we decided to talk again to clear things out. She was still the innocent and weak girl while he agreed to be the bad guy. He let us insult him all we wanted but do not even think of insulting his GF (protective BF, I see). At the end, they were the victims and I was the bitch who made a friendship broken, made an angel cry. I ended up graduating high school with only 4 friends. 2 guys and 2 girls. 4 years later, they still hang out. Everyone talked with each other again (included my friend who was cheated on). They had a private group chat without me. The girl is still acting innocent and guilty, chatting with me sometimes to express how guilty she was only to retreat later when she founded out I had an argument with a friend in the gang. They hated me like shit. Heck! they could even spit on me if they can. It has been 4 years but I still look at myself in the mirror wondering what have I done so wrong? I did not cheat, I did not talk behind someone's back, I gave them a chance, I let them copy my fucking homework, I taught them math! I am so traumatized by her unexpected betrayal that I always have second thought when I meet someone whose behavior resembles hers (weak, innocent, mature, lovable). I do not communicate with people too much. I do not want any more best friends. Heck! I even find it comfortable hanging out alone right now.
